title: Multiple religions talk about the astral plane—some even refer to it simply as Heaven. If it is confirmed there’s a type of dream you can experience this realm, then Heaven would come to Earth by an internal process, just as Jesus prophesied. And that’s only the beginning of what would unfold...
content: Many religions reference not only the Astral realm but also a divine celestial city said to exist within it. In Hinduism, ancient sages referred to the Astral realm as the Heaven of Svarga and named its celestial city *Devapura*, the City of the Devas and the capital of Svarga. This realm was described as a place of divine beauty, inhabited by Devas. Similarly, prophets from the Abrahamic religions were aware of this sacred realm. They spoke of a celestial city within it, referred to as the *New Jerusalem*. This city, described in the Bible’s Book of Revelation, symbolizes ultimate divine unity and serves as a spiritual destination for the faithful. If the phenomenon of Mallworld is us going to the Astral’s celestial metropolis in a type of dream, then Jesus’s prophecy of Heaven coming to Earth through an internal process would be fulfilled. People would literally be proclaiming Heaven is within if the evidence became overwhelming. In the same passage where Jesus mentions Heaven being located within, He says something fascinating: two people will be asleep in one bed, one will be taken, and the other left behind (**Luke 17:34**) Scientifically, the traditional Christian interpretation of the Rapture doesn’t fit this scenario. For someone to be physically taken to Heaven from their bed in the way many Christians imagine, they’d have to pass through the walls of their house with their body—which is physically impossible. However, being taken to Heaven in a dream is entirely possible. I’ll explore the mechanics of how this works in another post. What’s fascinating is that we know not everyone experiences Mallworld. Some people enter it, while others don’t, even if they’re in the same space. This perfectly aligns with Jesus’s prophecy: two people could literally be in the same bed, yet one might enter Heaven in a dream while the other does not. I know many pure-hearted individuals who are devoted followers of God, yet they don’t have the type of lucid dream that reveals Heaven. This will be easy for people to realize, which would open up a discussion regarding why some people experience the phenomenon and others do not. The world would eventually analyze those who experience it under it’s microscope, and this would reveal there is a very deep reason for why only a select few experience the Heaven… The Celestial City, while divine, isn’t a perfect paradise—at least not yet. It can be overwhelming, intense, and even terrifying. Although I’ve had many heartwarming and amazing experiences there, when I first encountered it, I might have considered those who didn’t experience it to be more fortunate. Hindu texts shed light on this, explaining that the Celestial City contains *Asuras*—beings akin to fallen angels. Similarly, the Bible mentions Satan’s army infiltrating the Holy City. Both traditions describe a war that must be won for the city to become a true paradise. Michael’s army, as foretold, will ultimately defeat the forces of evil, transforming the city into a place of peace and perfection. Many devoted followers of God don’t experience this realm because God and their guardian angels know they aren’t emotionally ready. The intensity of the experience could be traumatizing for some, so they are lovingly shielded from it until they’re prepared. For those of us who do experience it, however, the reason is extraordinary. Indigo children, often identifying as lightworkers, earth angels, or starseeds, frequently report these experiences. These individuals feel a profound calling to save humanity, a belief many have held since childhood, as if it were imprinted on their souls. If they are here to save humanity, it makes sense they would also be engaged in the spiritual battles described in scripture. As the Bible suggests, there is a war in Heaven, and these individuals may be part of it, fighting to eliminate evil in both realms and working to bring peace to Earth and Heaven. I believe after the war is over, anyone will be able to begin experiencing Heaven internally even at any point in their life. I believe the purpose of this rapture is to reveal that the world has the ability to connect with Heaven within themselves. This understanding will then profoundly transform the world in countless ways.
